attchmntText: Virinchi Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
voiceSummary: Virinchi Limited board meeting held on November 10, 2026, approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved raising funds via a preferential issue of up to 2,00,00,000 convertible equity warrants at Rs. 15 per warrant, aggregating up to Rs. 30,00,00,000. Proposed allottees include Viswanath Kompella for 1,50,00,000 warrants and IT Peer Technologies LLC for 50,00,000 warrants. This issuance is subject to shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for December 10, 2026. The EGM will be conducted through OAVM or VC. The cut-off date for e-voting eligibility is December 3, 2026. Remote e-voting opens on December 7, 2026, at 09:00 A.M. IST and closes on December 9, 2026, at 05:00 P.M. IST.

attchmntText: Virinchi Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
